meta.dataset: Bereznowski, Atroszko & Konarski (2023), Frontiers in Psychology 14:1130069 (data/code: https://osf.io/jvqfa/, CC BY 4.0)
meta.sample_description: 676 working Poles (mean age 36.12, SD 11.23), listwise-complete on BWAS-7/UWES-9/MBI-GS/PSS-10
meta.method: qgraph::cor_auto() correlations + bootnet::estimateNetwork(default='EBICglasso', threshold=TRUE), gamma=0.5 -- the paper's own estimation call. Reproduced here: 27 edges (paper: 27), mean|weight|=0.065 (paper: .06), max=0.422 (paper: .42). Community assignment is NOT re-detected (spin-glass is stochastic and was unstable on re-estimation); it is hardcoded from the paper's own reported 4-cluster spin-glass result (Results 3.2). expected_influence is derived here from the published edge matrix (signed row sums) -- the paper's own script does not report this metric, only standard node strength and a modified/bridge strength.
meta.community_detection_note: Modularity computed here on |edge weights| for the hardcoded published partition; the paper does not report a modularity value for its spin-glass solution.
meta.caveat: Cross-sectional data -- no causal interpretation warranted. EBIC-glasso regularization shrinks small partial correlations to exactly zero; an absent edge is not evidence the population association is zero.

nodes.description: Salience -- work dominates thoughts, feelings, and behavior (Bergen Work Addiction Scale item 1).
Tolerance -- needing to work increasingly more to achieve the same satisfaction (BWAS item 2).
Mood modification -- working to escape from or improve a negative mood (BWAS item 3).
Relapse -- attempts to cut down on work fail and old patterns resume (BWAS item 4).
Withdrawal -- becoming stressed or distressed when prevented from working (BWAS item 5).
Conflict -- work interferes with relationships, hobbies, or other activities (BWAS item 6).
Problems -- health or other problems caused by working too much (BWAS item 7).
Vigor -- high energy and mental resilience while working (UWES-9 subscale).
Dedication -- sense of significance, enthusiasm, pride, and challenge in one's work (UWES-9 subscale).
Absorption -- being fully concentrated and engrossed in one's work, with difficulty detaching (UWES-9 subscale).
Exhaustion -- feelings of energy depletion from work (MBI-GS subscale).
Cynicism -- increased mental distance from and negativism toward one's work (MBI-GS subscale).
Professional efficacy -- sense of competence and accomplishment at work (MBI-GS subscale; higher score = more efficacy, NOT reverse-coded).
Perceived stress -- general perceived stress over the past month (PSS-10 total score).
